description: This file defines the 'Spots' class, which extends the 'Basic' class in a SuiteCRM module. It includes properties for the module's schema, methods for saving and processing configuration data related to 'spots', and utility functions for label translation and key retrieval. The class handles configuration processing, localization, and security interface implementation specific to the 'Spots' module.

classes.name: Spots
classes.description: PHP class representing the 'Spots' module, handling configuration, localization, and access control for the SuiteCRM extension.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Determines if the class implements a specific interface, returning true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields for the module, encoding config data with labels.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves configuration data, translating labels to keys, updating the config JSON, and invoking parent save.

methods.name: replaceKeyValueWithLabel
methods.description: Replaces keys in config JSON with localized label strings based on current language.

methods.name: getKeysForLabels
methods.description: Retrieves keys for a list of labels, ensuring a single match per label.

methods.name: logSpotsErrorWithKeyMatching
methods.description: Logs an error when label-to-key matching results in multiple or zero matches.

methods.name: getKeyForLabel
methods.description: Returns the key(s) associated with a specific label for a given spot type.
